problem_text: A hemisphere with radius [R] sits on top of a horizontal circular disk with radius [R], and the hemisphere and disk have the same center. Let T be the region of points P in the disk such that a sphere of radius 42 can be placed on top of the disk at P and lie completely inside the hemisphere. The area of T divided by the area of the disk is p/q, where p and q are relatively prime positive integers. Find p+q.
